headline: XPO (XPO) Appoints Michael Kneeland To Board As Governance Picture Evolves
summary: XPO (NYSE:XPO) has appointed Michael Kneeland to its board of directors. Kneeland brings leadership experience from United Rentals, GXO Logistics and Gildan Activewear. The appointment adds logistics and equipment rental expertise to XPO's boardroom. Investors watching XPO may see this board change as an important governance development.
